findings.title: Materials' 54-point lens gap signals earnings hope
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.96x forward versus 36.21x trailing, a 53 percent compression that ranks at the 88th percentile on trailing earnings. The market is underwriting 113 percent earnings growth, an aggressive bet that the sector's reported profits are about to inflect sharply.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' forward multiple collapses to 19th percentile
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward P/E fell 35 percentile points in a month to 19.30, while its trailing multiple sits at the 79th percentile. That 60-point gap between lenses implies analysts expect 43 percent earnings growth, yet the market is pricing the forward view as if that growth is already failing.

findings.title: Communication Services' forward multiple at one-year low
findings.body: Communication Services trades at 13.66x forward, the 1st percentile of its five-year range, while trailing earnings sit at the 28th percentile. The 27-point gap and 36 percent compression imply the market is pricing in a 57 percent earnings surge, but the extreme forward discount suggests skepticism that it will arrive.
